topic: Updating randomized forecast for multiple months
summary_markdown:
The discussion concerns updating a previously created randomized forecast (DOOH-1734). The initial test covered November, and the request is to extend the calculation for December and January as well. This extension is needed to compare new methods across a full period and update client data.

[me] confirmed that the task was originally intended to cover multiple months. [p1] questioned if only November had been calculated or if more was done, leading [me] to clarify that only November was completed while awaiting confirmation on the feasibility of an idea proposed by someone.
decisions: The randomized forecast calculation needs to be extended to include December and January.
action_items: [me] to calculate and update the randomized forecast for December and January, adding it to the existing task/project.
